quotes: The residence permit is valid for 10 years and can be extended if the same conditions are met.
The applicant must own a property or a group of properties with a total value of no less than AED 2 million.
If the ownership is in the form of a share in a joint property, the value of the share must not be less than AED 2 million.
mortgaged property is acceptable
It is required to place a lien on the property to ensure the continuity of ownership throughout the validity of the Golden Residency
property may not be disposed of nor the financial deposit refunded
Owning a bank deposit of no less than AED 2 million.
stating that it has been frozen for a period of no less than two years.
Withdrawal of the deposit or investment is not permitted throughout the Golden Residency period (10 years).
Submit a tax certificate issued by the Federal Tax Authority in the UAE.
Proof that the total value of taxes paid annually is no less than AED 250,000
Expected Completion Time 5.0 Day(s)
(Al Tarash Center - Gulf Vision - Golden Cube - Al Yalayis - AGS H)
1. Visit the nearest Amer Service centres.
